categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yitong High-tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three segments: manufacturing and sales of broadcasting television equipment including cable TV network transmission devices, intelligent video monitoring engineering services based on cable TV technology, and research, design, and sales of integrated circuits, chips, and sensors for wearable devices. The company also engages in software development and technical support related to cable TV network systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as PPG bio-sensor modules integrating self-developed analog front-end (AFE) chips, optical receivers, and AI algorithms for health monitoring. It develops ultra-low power AI processor chips based on RISC-V architecture, supporting continuous sensor data processing. Manufacturing follows a fabless model for chips and sensors, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries, while maintaining in-house design and quality control. The company also develops cable TV network equipment using optical fiber transmission, coaxial cable transmission, and data communication technologies like GEPON and MoCA.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include provincial cable TV network operators, government entities for intelligent video monitoring projects, and manufacturers of smart wearable devices. The company serves industries such as broadcasting, telecommunications, public security, healthcare, smart home, and automotive electronics. Major end markets are domestic Chinese cable TV operators and international markets, with significant sales to affiliated companies like Anhui Huami Information Technology Co., Ltd.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with major business concentrated in the eastern region (over 80% of revenue), and also serves other domestic regions including northeast, north, south, central, southwest, and northwest China. It has expanded into overseas markets, particularly in Europe and the Americas, though foreign sales declined significantly in the reporting period.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yitong operates mainly in the midstream and upstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and manufactures broadcasting equipment and chips (fabless design), outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging. It also provides engineering services downstream to end customers such as cable operators and government agencies. The company is positioned as a technology developer and equipment supplier within the broadcasting and IoT ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in ultra-low power AI processor chips, health monitoring bio-sensors, and cable TV network transmission technologies including fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and MoCA-based home networking. It focuses on integrating hardware, software, and AI algorithms to deliver system-level solutions for smart wearables, AIoT, smart homes, and intelligent automotive applications. Strategic collaboration with Huami Technology supports large-scale market adoption. The company also invests in new product development for digital video monitoring and cable network upgrades aligned with 5G and smart broadcasting trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of broadcasting equipment, chips, and sensor modules, as well as engineering service fees for intelligent video monitoring projects. Sales are mostly direct to cable TV operators, government agencies, and affiliated companies. The company also earns income from licensing and technology services related to its chip and sensor products. Non-operating income includes government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the broadcasting equipment and semiconductor design industries, facing intense competition in the cable TV equipment market with low barriers to entry and price competition. It leverages its R&D capabilities, patents, and strategic partnerships to differentiate in the emerging AIoT and wearable chip markets. Its position is strengthened by its affiliation with Huami Technology, a leading player in smart wearables, providing a competitive edge in chip integration and market access.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 101.3 million, a 44.41% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.9 million, significantly worsening from the prior year. The decline was mainly due to reduced demand in cable TV equipment and sensor modules. R&D expenses increased by 6.08% to RMB 55.9 million, reflecting ongoing investment in new technologies. The company’s total assets were about RMB 631 million, with a slight increase from the prior year. The company is in a transition phase with growth potential in chip and sensor markets but faces short-term financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Yitong emphasizes its core R&D strengths in ultra-low power AI chips and PPG bio-sensor modules that enable precise, continuous health monitoring for wearable devices. Its integrated hardware-software-algorithm solutions provide differentiated value in smart wearables, AIoT, and intelligent automotive applications. The company’s long-standing expertise in cable TV network equipment and its strategic partnership with Huami Technology enhance its ability to deliver innovative, cost-effective products with strong market adoption potential. Its patented technologies and comprehensive service offerings in intelligent video monitoring further strengthen its competitive positioning.
